tldr: For every strictly positive table on \(\mathbb Z_m\), conditional row and column translation orbits characterize all arbitrary-function modular additive-noise explanations in both directions, compress them as stabilizer-coset products, and yield at most two single-variable intervention systems in \(O(m^2)\) exact operations. On the fully positive affine-unit subclass, reverse representability is additionally equivalent to \(H_p+H_q=\mathbb Z_m\), or coprimality of the normalized input and noise periods, and the CRT formulas give every mechanism, residual, alias, and intervention law. The generic orbit certificate applies to Suzuki et al.'s full positive injective-forward class, but the complementary-stabilizer classification, slope formulas, and finite-sample confidence fiber remain affine-unit results. Separation-aware inference orients separated laws and retains intersecting reversible strata; local \(n^{-1/2}\) alternatives show why uniform forced orientation is impossible.
gap: The closest theorem is prime-power only under full positivity, while its own positive nonuniform \(m=6\) example shows that composite moduli have qualitatively different reversible families. Existing work does not visibly give the arbitrary-composite iff, all arbitrary backward functions, or the induced intervention fiber.
